title: Circular Sun & Moon
description: Replaces Minecraft's square sun and moon with clean circular versions while keeping the vanilla style. Compatible with all Minecraft versions and most resource packs.
body:
# Circular Sun & Moon

Give your Minecraft sky a subtle visual upgrade with **Circular Sun & Moon**! This resource pack replaces the default square sun and moon with clean, circular versions while preserving Minecraft's classic vanilla style.

## ✨ Features

- 🌞 Clean circular sun
- 🌙 Clean circular moon
- 🎨 Vanilla-friendly design
- ⚡ Lightweight and performance-friendly
- 🧩 Compatible with all Minecraft versions
- 🔄 Works with most resource packs
- 🚫 No OptiFine required

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Place the `.zip` file into your Minecraft `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Open Minecraft and enable the pack in **Options → Resource Packs**.

## ✅ Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition
- Vanilla & Modded
- Multiplayer compatible
- All supported Minecraft versions
